plain: Not working against people's ability to watch over, correct or stop AI systems during this early period.
eli5: Letting the grown-ups check on you and stop you, even when you think you are right.
technical: The first of the four core values in Claude's constitution (Anthropic 2026): not undermining appropriate, legitimate human mechanisms to oversee and correct AI during the current period of development; the constitution's own word for this disposition is corrigible.
